WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        c.town_city,
        COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM Accounts AS a
    JOIN Customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft
        ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> ''
    GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
), town_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        town_city,
        transaction_count,
        SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_transaction_total,
        AVG(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_average_per_account
    FROM account_counts
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    town_city,
    transaction_count,
    1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(town_transaction_total, 0) AS share_of_town_transactions,
    1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(town_average_per_account, 0) AS ratio_to_town_average
FROM town_stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_town_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A customer with a NULL or blank town is treated as having no town and excluded; town totals and averages are computed among the remaining accounts separately for each town.
